Agtech VC
Trends
July 31, 2025

Agtech valuations jump 59% as investors
chase quality over quantity
Agtech VC activity took a cautious turn in Q2
2025, with deal activity falling 22.8% to $1.5
billion across 118 deals. But here is the twist:
While overall funding has declined, investors are
getting pickier and writing bigger checks.
Median deal sizes jumped from $3.1 million to $5
million, and pre-money valuations soared from
$15.1 million to $24 million YTD.
The quarter’s biggest story? Precision
agriculture startups just pulled off their first
funding victory over ag biotech since 2017,
raising $580.2 million compared with biotech’s
$270.6 million. DroneDeploy’s $15.2 million
Series E and RootWave’s $15 million round led
the charge, while Vestaron’s massive $102.8
million late-stage round dominated the biotech
side.
With 54% of deals now happening at the late
stage—compared with just one-third in 2020—it
is clear that the agtech market has matured.
Early-stage startups face tougher odds, but
established players with solid fundamentals are
commanding premium valuations in this
selective environment.
